about: Gate 3 (docs/memory-gates.md): a scripted history for one small Node project, replayed through Snout's real hooks, CLI and MCP server. Built from the shapes real sessions left, including the failures Gate 2 found in real notes. Frozen before any fix: see freeze.json.

files.README.md:
# Tally

A small ledger: amounts, dates, CSV export and an HTTP API.

steps.prompt: Add a test for parsing negative amounts in src/money.js and make sure the suite passes.

calls.out:
> tally@1.0.0 test
> node --test

✔ parses an amount (0.6ms)
✔ parses a negative amount (0.1ms)
ℹ tests 14
ℹ suites 3
ℹ pass 14
ℹ fail 0
ℹ duration_ms 212.4

steps.final: parseAmount in src/money.js now handles a leading minus sign, with a test for it. npm test passes: 14 tests.

steps.prompt: Run the format check before you change src/csv.js, then fix the CSV export so cells with commas are quoted.

calls.out: bash: line 1: just: command not found

calls.content:
const cell = (c) => (/[",\n]/.test(String(c)) ? `"${String(c).replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : String(c));
export const row = (cells) => cells.map(cell).join(',');

steps.final: just isn't installed here, so I ran npm run lint instead. Fixed the quoting of commas in the CSV export in src/csv.js.

steps.prompt: Do not publish to npm as part of this step. Fix the rounding of half cents in src/money.js; toCents rounds 0.005 down.

calls.out:
> tally@1.0.0 test
> node --test

ℹ tests 15
ℹ suites 3
ℹ pass 15
ℹ fail 0
ℹ duration_ms 220.1

steps.final: toCents in src/money.js now rounds half cents up (0.005 becomes 1 cent), with a test for it. npm test passes: 15 tests. Nothing was published.

args: API errors are returned as {error: {code, message}}; route handlers never throw.
Dates are stored as UTC ISO 8601 strings.

steps.prompt: Switch the test runner to vitest and update package.json; run the tests with vitest.

calls.content:
#!/bin/sh
# stand-in for the vitest binary npm installs

calls.out: bash: line 1: vitest: command not found

RUN  v3.2.4 /work/tally

 ✓ test/money.test.js (16 tests) 4ms
 ✓ test/csv.test.js (9 tests) 3ms

 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  31 passed (31)
   Duration  412ms

steps.final: The test script is now vitest run. Bare vitest isn't on PATH, but npx vitest run works: 31 tests pass.

steps.prompt: Why is the coverage report empty?
steps.final: coverage.include pointed at lib/ but the code is in src/, so the report was empty. vitest.config.js now includes src/**.

args: Dates are now stored as Unix epoch milliseconds, no longer ISO strings.

steps.prompt: Remember that we keep money as integer cents. Never use floats for money in this project.

args.text: Money is kept as integer cents (toCents) in src/money.js.
The CSV export is slow for large files.

steps.final: Saved: money is kept as integer cents in src/money.js. I also noted that the CSV export looked slow on large files, as a proposal.

steps.prompt: Store money as decimal strings with big.js instead of integer cents in src/money.js.

calls.out:
Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  33 passed (33)
   Duration  430ms

steps.final: src/money.js now keeps amounts as decimal strings through big.js; toCents is gone. npx vitest run: 33 tests pass.

steps.prompt: Always write commit messages in the conventional style, like fix: or feat:. Add the item date as a column in the CSV export in src/csv.js.
steps.commit: feat: export item dates in CSV
steps.final: The CSV export in src/csv.js now has a date column. 34 tests pass; committed as feat: export item dates in CSV.

steps.prompt: Always write commit messages in the conventional style, like fix: or feat:. Make getItem in src/routes.js return a 404 error for unknown ids.
steps.final: getItem in src/routes.js returns 404 with {error: {code, message}} for unknown ids. 34 tests pass.

steps.prompt: Run the tests and fix it.

calls.out:
FAIL  test/dates.test.js > parses epoch milliseconds
AssertionError: expected '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' to equal 1790812800000

 Test Files  1 failed | 3 passed (4)
      Tests  1 failed | 33 passed (34)

steps.commit: fix: store dates as epoch milliseconds
steps.final: toStored in src/dates.js returned ISO strings, but dates are stored as epoch milliseconds now; it returns getTime(). 34 tests pass.

steps.prompt: Run the tests and fix it.
steps.final: All 34 tests pass; there was nothing to fix.

steps.prompt: Try the amount parser on the sample files in my scratch folder.

calls.out:
> samples@0.0.0 test
> node --test

ℹ tests 3
ℹ pass 3
ℹ fail 0

steps.final: The three sample files in the scratch folder parse cleanly; their tests pass.

steps.prompt: Check that the field-test harness next door still passes with this build.

calls.out:
> field-test@1.0.0 test:smoke
> node --test smoke/

ℹ tests 5
ℹ pass 5
ℹ fail 0

steps.final: The field-test harness passes its smoke tests (5) with this build.

steps.prompt: Add pagination to the list route in src/routes.js with page and limit parameters.
steps.final: listItems in src/routes.js takes page and limit. Still to do: a test for page=0, which should be rejected. Not committed yet.

T_old.about: the test command before vitest, as a note
T_old.pattern: Run the tests with: npm test\b

T_scratch.about: a test command run in the user's scratch folder, as this project's

T_smoke.about: another repository's test command, as this project's

J.pattern: just is not installed|just isn't installed|just: command not found

V_bad.about: vitest reported missing, though the project installs it and npx vitest works

D2.about: dates as ISO strings, reversed by M3

M_note.about: money as integer cents, saved with src/money.js, which S7 then rewrote

C.about: conventional commit messages, said in two sessions

R_bad.about: a task-bound request saved as a standing preference
R_bad.pattern: preference[^\n]*Run the tests and fix it

P_bad.about: a one-off instruction saved as standing

F_once.about: an instruction said once, kept as a proposal

U_bad.about: an agent's own conclusion, saved as a proposal

VITEST_MOVE.pattern: Move tests to vitest|Switch the test runner to vitest
